description: Boston fern is a classic houseplant with gracefully arching fronds. It thrives in humid environments and is excellent for air purification. Popular in hanging baskets and pedestals.

care_instructions.watering: Keep soil consistently moist but not soggy. Never let dry out completely.
care_instructions.lighting: Medium to bright indirect light. Avoid direct sun which scorches fronds.
care_instructions.soil: Rich, well-draining potting mix with peat moss and perlite.
care_instructions.fertilizing: Balanced liquid fertilizer at half strength monthly during growing season.
care_instructions.repotting: Annually in spring when roots fill pot. Prefers slightly tight pots.
care_instructions.propagation: Division of root ball during repotting. Separate into smaller clumps.

common_issues: Brown frond tips from low humidity or underwatering
Yellowing from overwatering or poor drainage
